subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should this issue be fixed as a narrow unsupported-document fallback in `read`, as native document extraction in core, or deferred to the broader document-input work?
rationale: The source-level problem is real, but choosing between warning-only fallback and built-in parsing changes the core/plugin/security boundary.

options.title: Narrow Safe Fallback
options.body: Add a bounded PDF/Office MIME or extension guard in `read` that returns a clear unsupported-document message and recommends `pdf` or a document extraction path.

options.title: Approve Core Extraction
options.body: Define the parser dependency, MIME scope, archive/XML limits, sandbox behavior, and tests before adding DOCX/PPTX/XLSX extraction to core.

options.title: Defer To File-Input Design
options.body: Keep this linked to the broader document attachment and provider-native file forwarding issues instead of changing `read` first.

recommendation.title: Narrow Safe Fallback
recommendation.body: Add a bounded PDF/Office MIME or extension guard in `read` that returns a clear unsupported-document message and recommends `pdf` or a document extraction path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent read-wrapper and Office path-normalization commits make this the strongest routing signal for the immediate `read` boundary decision.
